TC-23-001.title: E2E-01 Job: agent creates and dispatches a job; the driver takes, drives to, reaches, photographs and finishes it in the app; the portal shows it CLOSED
TC-23-001.pre: Android emulator with the UAT provider app (com.aspire.partner.uat), truck v3036 bound to the test provider; agent login on the RSA portal (UAT); truck GPS at its base, Victory Monument (13.7649, 100.5383), ~5 km from the customer
TC-23-001.data: Client Honda (380), program HOT UAT Program, service Basic Repair; customer [AUTO-TEST] Jaidee; incident 13.7334, 100.5408 (Ratchadamri Rd by Lumphini Park); odometer 48215
TC-23-001.status: Automated - PASSED 22 Oct 2026 (job 26JB049155, 3.7 min); also 20 Oct (job 26JB049153)
steps: Sign in as the driver, choose truck v3036, switch Ready on
Dashboard shows VIN v3036 and Ready = On
Driver signs in, truck v3036, Ready on

Sign in as the agent and create a Basic Repair job: client Honda, program HOT UAT Program, customer [AUTO-TEST] Jaidee, Thai incident address (ถ.ราชดำริ หน้าสวนลุมพินี, ปทุมวัน, กทม.), licence 1กข 2345, location note and service condition; Save
Job number is issued; the values are kept after reload
Set the incident pin on the map at 13.7334, 100.5408
Assign truck v3036 and click Dispatch
Truck and dispatch time are saved; status stays OPEN
Agent assigns truck v3036 and dispatches
Wait on the dashboard without refreshing
A job card with the same job number appears, more than 2 km away (9.70 km on 20 Oct)
Job card appears on the phone
Open the job and tap Take Job
Job is accepted; the portal shows the accept time and status ONPROCESS
Drive ~5 km by road to the customer (GPS point every ~150 m: Victory Monument - Phaya Thai - Rama I - Ratchadamri)
App follows the route; the portal road distance is more than 2 km
Portal shows the reach time and mileage 48215
Take a photo with the camera and tap Done
Photo is listed in the app; portal photo count is 1
Status CLOSED; request < accept < reach < complete; ACCEPT, REACH and COMPLETE rows stamped by truck v3036 with GPS; KPI Pass
Portal shows CLOSED with the driver's timestamps

TC-23-003.title: E2E-02 Announcement: admin publishes an announcement on the web; drivers see it in the app; deactivating it removes it from the app
TC-23-003.pre: Android emulator with the UAT provider app, driver signed in; administrator (R0001) login on the RSA portal - administrator submits are approved at once. Announcements cannot be targeted: every UAT provider app sees it, so it is always deactivated at the end
TC-23-003.data: Title "[AUTO-TEST] Road closure Rama IV <timestamp>", priority High, content "Rama IV Rd closed between Sam Yan and Lumphini 22:00-05:00. Use Rama I or Sukhumvit.", effective today, expiry tomorrow
TC-23-003.status: Automated - PASSED 22 Oct 2026 (1.6 min, announcement switched off at the end)
steps: Driver is signed in, on the dashboard
Sign in as administrator; Announcements > Create New: title, priority High, content, effective today, expiry tomorrow, Active; click Submit & Publish
Announcement is saved and approved at once
Admin creates a High announcement and publishes
Row shows priority High, Active, status Approved
Read the feed the app uses: GET api/pmws/announcements
Open the News tab and tap the card
Card shows the title; the content expands
Edit the announcement, untick Active, Update
